blocks.zh: 環境風險評估框架與關鍵性因子（4.0–4.3）
blocks.en: Environmental Risk Assessment Framework and Criticality Factors (4.0–4.3)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解低生物負荷設施的三層風險評估體系：設施風險評估、製程風險評估、EM風險評估，以及三者的分工與銜接關係
blocks.en: Understand the three-tier risk assessment system for low bioburden facilities (facility risk assessment, process risk assessment, EM risk assessment) and how the three divide the work and connect

blocks.zh: 掌握八大污染源的關鍵性因子（Criticality Factors），特別是人員、物料/廢棄物、設施設計三大主類及其子項目
blocks.en: Master the criticality factors for the eight sources of contamination, especially the three main categories (personnel, materials/waste, facility design) and their sub-items

blocks.zh: 能夠應用三組關鍵性因子（Group 1製程步驟 / Group 2潛在污染貢獻者 / Group 3異常污染源）進行EM位置與頻率設計
blocks.en: Be able to apply the three groups of criticality factors (Group 1 process steps / Group 2 potential contributors to contamination / Group 3 abnormal contamination sources) to design EM locations and frequencies

blocks.zh: 深入解讀Table 4.3.1-1的High/Medium/Low風險矩陣，並能應用於哺乳動物細胞培養製程的實際情境
blocks.en: Interpret the High/Medium/Low risk matrix in Table 4.3.1-1 in depth and apply it to real mammalian cell culture scenarios

blocks.zh: 理解Table 4.3.3-1的監控頻率邏輯：High Risk每次關鍵操作、Medium Risk每週、Low Risk兩週一次或每週
blocks.en: Understand the monitoring frequency logic of Table 4.3.3-1: High Risk at every critical operation, Medium Risk weekly, Low Risk every two weeks or weekly

blocks.zh: Three-tier RA system: facility / process / EM risk assessments • 環境風險評估三層體系
blocks.en: Three-tier RA system: facility / process / EM risk assessments

blocks.zh: 解析：三層風險評估架構
blocks.en: Analysis: The Three-Tier Risk Assessment Structure

blocks.zh: 三種風險評估的分工
blocks.en: How the Three Risk Assessments Divide the Work

blocks.zh: TR13-2在一開始就明確區分三種RA，各有不同的問題意識：
blocks.en: TR13-2 clearly distinguishes three types of RA right from the start, each asking a different question:

blocks.zh: 設施（環境）風險評估：「這個設施適合做這個製程嗎？」評估廠房結構、氣流設計、房間分級是否與製程匹配
blocks.en: Facility (environmental) risk assessment: "Is this facility suitable for this process?" Evaluates whether building structure, airflow design and room classification match the process

blocks.zh: 製程風險評估：「製程本身哪些步驟有汙染風險？」以操作視角，找出每個製程步驟的潛在汙染點
blocks.en: Process risk assessment: "Which steps of the process carry contamination risk?" Takes an operational view to identify the potential contamination points in each process step

blocks.zh: EM風險評估：「已知上述風險後，如何用EM監控體系加以追蹤控制？」決定監控位置、頻率、方法
blocks.en: EM risk assessment: "Given the risks above, how do we track and control them with the EM system?" Determines monitoring locations, frequency and methods

blocks.zh: TR13-2的定位
blocks.en: Positioning of TR13-2

blocks.zh: 本技術報告的核心主題是第三層——EM風險評估。設施RA與製程RA是先決條件，EM RA是在它們的基礎上，設計一套能夠有效偵測並控制汙染風險的監控計畫。
blocks.en: The core subject of this technical report is the third tier, the EM risk assessment. The facility RA and process RA are prerequisites; building on them, the EM RA designs a monitoring program that can effectively detect and control contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 請特別注意：EM RA不只是設計初始EM計畫，當出現汙染事件或不良趨勢時（例如某製程管路出現微生物汙染，或EM資料呈現上升趨勢），也應觸發EM RA的重新審視或調查性評估。
blocks.en: Note in particular that the EM RA is not only for designing the initial EM program. When a contamination event or adverse trend occurs (for example, microbial contamination in a process line, or an upward trend in EM data), it should also trigger a re-examination or investigational assessment of the EM RA.

blocks.zh: 比喻：保全系統的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: the design logic of a security system

blocks.zh:
設施RA = 評估建築本身的安全性（門窗是否完整、進出口設計是否合理）
製程RA = 評估日常作業的風險（哪些活動容易引入外部人員或可疑物品）
EM RA = 決定在哪裡裝攝影機、多久查看一次錄像、高風險區域是否需要24小時監控
blocks.en:
Facility RA = assessing the security of the building itself (are doors and windows intact, is the entry/exit design reasonable)
Process RA = assessing the risk of daily activities (which activities are likely to bring in outsiders or suspicious items)
EM RA = deciding where to install cameras, how often to review the footage, and whether high-risk areas need 24-hour monitoring

blocks.zh: Process flow map • Multifunctional team • Facility tours • 流程圖繪製與多功能團隊
blocks.en: Process flow map - Multifunctional team - Facility tours

blocks.zh: 解析：RA執行的基礎工具
blocks.en: Analysis: Foundational Tools for Performing the RA

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖（Process Flow Map）的核心功能
blocks.en: Core function of the process flow map

blocks.zh: 在進行EM風險評估之前，必須先完成製程流程圖的繪製。這不是可選步驟，而是確保RA「不遺漏任何關鍵步驟」的根本保障。一份完整的製程流程圖應整合：
blocks.en: Before an EM risk assessment is performed, the process flow map must be completed. This is not an optional step; it is the fundamental safeguard that the RA does not miss any critical step. A complete process flow map should integrate:

blocks.zh: 生產記錄（Batch Records）：記錄每個操作步驟的順序與細節
blocks.en: Batch records: record the sequence and details of each operating step

blocks.zh: 標準操作程序（SOPs）：確認每個步驟的實際操作方式
blocks.en: Standard operating procedures (SOPs): confirm how each step is actually performed

blocks.zh: 人員/設備/物料流向圖：標示汙染可能的傳播路徑
blocks.en: Personnel/equipment/material flow diagrams: show the possible pathways of contamination spread

blocks.zh: 管線與儀器圖（P&ID）：釐清系統的開放性或密閉性
blocks.en: Piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&ID): clarify whether the system is open or closed

blocks.zh: 多功能團隊（Multifunctional Team）
blocks.en: Multifunctional team

blocks.zh: TR13-2強調EM RA應由多功能團隊執行，典型成員包括：
blocks.en: TR13-2 stresses that the EM RA should be performed by a multifunctional team. Typical members include:

blocks.zh: 驗證工程（Validation）：提供確認/驗證視角
blocks.en: Validation: provides the qualification/validation perspective

blocks.zh: 製造（Manufacturing）：熟悉實際操作細節
blocks.en: Manufacturing: knows the actual operating details

blocks.zh: 品保（Quality Assurance）：確保符合法規要求
blocks.en: Quality Assurance: ensures regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 廠務（Facilities/Engineering）：了解設施設計與HVAC
blocks.en: Facilities/Engineering: understands facility design and HVAC

blocks.zh: 微生物學（Microbiology）：提供汙染源專業判斷
blocks.en: Microbiology: provides expert judgment on contamination sources

blocks.zh: 最佳實務是：系統擁有者先完成流程圖，再交給多功能團隊進行RA，確保RA範圍已被清楚界定。
blocks.en: Best practice: the system owner completes the flow map first, then hands it to the multifunctional team for the RA, so that the scope of the RA is clearly defined.

blocks.zh: 廠房巡視的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of facility tours

blocks.zh: 僅靠文件作業進行RA容易產生「紙上RA」的問題——流程圖上看起來合理，實際廠房卻存在文件未記載的風險（例如管線暴露在外、牆面有裂縫、排水口位置不當）。TR13-2明確推薦進行廠房實地巡視，搭配流程圖，才能收集到用於決定關鍵性因子的完整資訊。
blocks.en: An RA based on documents alone easily becomes a "paper RA": the flow map looks reasonable, but the actual facility has risks that the documents do not record (for example, exposed piping, cracks in walls, poorly placed drains). TR13-2 clearly recommends facility tours together with the flow map in order to collect the complete information used to determine criticality factors.

blocks.zh: Eight sources of contamination • Personnel / Materials / Facility Design • 八大潛在污染源
blocks.en: Eight sources of contamination - Personnel / Materials / Facility Design

blocks.zh: 解析：關鍵性因子與污染源
blocks.en: Analysis: Criticality Factors and Sources of Contamination

blocks.zh: 關鍵性因子的定義
blocks.en: Definition of criticality factors

blocks.zh: 「關鍵性因子」（Criticality Factors）是用來評估各種汙染源對製程、產品或環境造成汙染風險的指標。TR13-2將主要汙染源分為三大類，對應4.2.1到4.2.3.5共八個小節。
blocks.en: "Criticality factors" are the indicators used to assess the risk that various sources of contamination pose to the process, product or environment. TR13-2 divides the main sources of contamination into three major categories, corresponding to eight subsections from 4.2.1 to 4.2.3.5.

blocks.zh: 重要前提：這些因子適用於任何設施，RA團隊在選用時，應只選擇與本次RA範圍相關的因子。
blocks.en: Key premise: these factors apply to any facility; when using them, the RA team should select only the factors relevant to the scope of the current RA.

blocks.zh: 4.2.1 人員——最大風險來源
blocks.en: 4.2.1 Personnel: the largest source of risk

blocks.zh: TR13-2明確指出：人體是製造環境中最大的汙染風險來源。人體每分鐘脫落數萬個皮膚鱗屑，每次移動都可能揚起微粒。因此EM計畫的設計必須反映「人員管控措施的完善程度」。
blocks.en: TR13-2 states clearly: people are the largest source of contamination risk in a manufacturing environment. The human body sheds tens of thousands of skin flakes per minute, and every movement can stir up particles. The EM program design must therefore reflect "how well personnel controls are implemented".

blocks.zh: 關鍵管控措施梯度（風險由高到低）：
blocks.en: Gradient of key controls (from higher to lower risk):

blocks.zh: 人員數量上限（Maximum Personnel Load）：人越少，汙染潛力越低
blocks.en: Maximum personnel load (Maximum Personnel Load): the fewer the people, the lower the contamination potential

blocks.zh: 人員流向設計：單向流（Unidirectional）優於雙向流（Bidirectional）
blocks.en: Personnel flow design: unidirectional flow is better than bidirectional flow

blocks.zh: 著裝/無菌技術：完整無菌著裝 + 無菌手套換戴頻率
blocks.en: Gowning/aseptic technique: full sterile gowning + frequency of sterile glove changes

blocks.zh: 觀察廊設計：若工程設計可讓作業員不需進入製造區，則EM需求相對降低
blocks.en: Observation corridor design: if the engineering design allows operators to avoid entering the manufacturing area, the EM needs are correspondingly reduced

blocks.zh: EM程式的監控強度應與「人員管控措施的完善程度」成反比——管控越嚴密，EM對人員相關風險的權重可適當調低。
blocks.en: The intensity of the EM program should be inversely proportional to "how well personnel controls are implemented": the tighter the controls, the lower the weight that EM can reasonably give to personnel-related risk.

blocks.zh: 4.2.2 物料與廢棄物
blocks.en: 4.2.2 Materials and waste

blocks.zh: 每一種進入製造區的物料（原料、輔料、過濾器、零件、標籤、包材）都是潛在的汙染載體。關鍵決策點：
blocks.en: Every material entering the manufacturing area (raw materials, supplementary materials, filters, parts, labels, packaging materials) is a potential carrier of contamination. Key decision points:

blocks.zh: 消毒（Disinfection）還是滅菌（Sterilization）？根據物料用途與接觸風險等級決定
blocks.en: Disinfection or sterilization? Decided by the intended use of the material and the level of contact risk

blocks.zh: 廢棄物流向：廢棄物出口應與物料入口分開，避免交叉汙染
blocks.en: Waste flow: the waste exit should be separate from the material entrance to avoid cross-contamination

blocks.zh: EM取樣點：應包含物料與廢棄物的轉移點（transfer points）——這些位置的汙染風險在轉移當下最高
blocks.en: EM sampling locations: should include the transfer points for materials and waste; the contamination risk at these locations is highest at the moment of transfer

blocks.zh: 解析：設施設計的五個子因子
blocks.en: Analysis: The Five Sub-Factors of Facility Design

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 設施設計基本要求
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Basic facility design requirements

blocks.zh: 設施設計是整個汙染控制策略的物理基礎。TR13-2列出的最低要求旨在支持有效的清潔與消毒作業：
blocks.en: Facility design is the physical foundation of the entire contamination control strategy. The minimum requirements listed in TR13-2 are intended to support effective cleaning and disinfection:

blocks.zh: 表面特性：光滑、不滲透、無吸附性——防止微生物藏匿
blocks.en: Surface properties: smooth, impervious and non-absorbent, to keep microorganisms from harboring

blocks.zh: 圓弧接縫（Coved Junctions）：牆壁與地板交接處應為圓弧而非直角，消除難以清潔的角落
blocks.en: Coved junctions (Coved Junctions): where walls meet floors, junctions should be coved rather than right-angled, eliminating corners that are hard to clean

blocks.zh: 無縫地板：消除接縫處藏汙納垢的可能
blocks.en: Seamless flooring: eliminates seams where dirt could collect

blocks.zh: 外露面積最小化：管線盡量藏入夾層，減少需要清潔的表面
blocks.en: Minimized exposed area: route piping into interstitial spaces where possible, reducing the surfaces that need cleaning

blocks.zh: 若RA過程中發現設施設計存在缺陷，必須透過改善措施（Mitigation）解決，並用EM數據驗證改善效果。
blocks.en: If the RA finds a deficiency in facility design, it must be resolved through mitigation, and the effectiveness of the mitigation verified with EM data.

blocks.zh: 4.2.3.1 清潔與消毒（C&D）
blocks.en: 4.2.3.1 Cleaning and disinfection (C&D)

blocks.zh: C&D的種類（消毒劑/殺孢劑）、頻率和方法直接影響EM計畫設計：
blocks.en: The type of C&D (disinfectant/sporicide), its frequency and method directly affect EM program design:

blocks.zh: 現有設施：C&D頻率應依據歷史EM資料驗證
blocks.en: Existing facilities: C&D frequency should be justified by historical EM data

blocks.zh: 新設施：應依照TR70進行現場確認（in-situ qualification），在缺乏歷史數據時，應採用更頻繁的監控計畫直到累積足夠數據
blocks.en: New facilities: in-situ qualification should be performed in accordance with TR70; where no historical data exist, a more frequent monitoring program should be used until sufficient data have been accumulated

blocks.zh: 4.2.3.2 製程設計：開放 vs. 密閉系統
blocks.en: 4.2.3.2 Process design: open vs. closed systems

blocks.zh: 這是影響EM設計最關鍵的單一因子之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most critical single factors affecting EM design:

blocks.zh: 開放系統（Open）：產品直接暴露於環境，需要最高等級的EM覆蓋
blocks.en: Open system: the product is directly exposed to the environment and requires the highest level of EM coverage

blocks.zh: 功能性密閉系統（Functionally Closed）：局部保護下的開放連接，EM需求中等
blocks.en: Functionally closed system: open connections under local protection; moderate EM needs

blocks.zh: 完全密閉系統（Fully Closed）：隔離器或硬管系統，EM需求顯著降低
blocks.en: Fully closed system: isolator or hard-piped systems; EM needs are significantly lower

blocks.zh: 自動化程度越高、手動操作越少，汙染潛力越低。
blocks.en: The higher the degree of automation and the less manual intervention, the lower the contamination potential.
4.2.3.3 Product characteristics

blocks.zh: 一個常被忽視但至關重要的因子：
blocks.en: A factor that is often overlooked but is critically important:

blocks.zh: 促生長型（Growth-promoting）：細胞培養基、血清培養液 → 微生物極易繁殖 → 需更嚴密的EM
blocks.en: Growth-promoting: cell culture media, serum-containing media -> microorganisms multiply easily -> tighter EM is needed

blocks.zh: 抑生長型（Growth-inhibiting）：高鹽濃度緩衝液、某些純化材料 → 微生物難以增殖 → EM強度可相對調整
blocks.en: Growth-inhibiting: high-salt buffers, some purification materials -> microorganisms have difficulty proliferating -> EM intensity can be adjusted accordingly
4.2.3.4 Environmental air

blocks.zh: 空氣是微生物傳播的重要媒介。EM計畫設計時需考量：
blocks.en: Air is an important vehicle for microbial spread. When designing the EM program, consider:

blocks.zh: HVAC設計：送風/回風/排風的配置是否會造成汙染區空氣流入潔淨區
blocks.en: HVAC design: whether the arrangement of supply/return/exhaust could cause air from contaminated areas to flow into clean areas

blocks.zh: 換氣次數（ACH）：決定空氣稀釋速率，ACH越高，微粒清除越快
blocks.en: Air changes per hour (ACH): determines the rate of air dilution; the higher the ACH, the faster particles are removed

blocks.zh: 局部單向流（UDF/LAF）：在關鍵操作點提供ISO 5等級的局部保護
blocks.en: Unidirectional airflow (UDF/LAF): provides local ISO 5 protection at critical operating points

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究（Smoke Studies）：視覺化驗證氣流方向，確認無渦流或死角
blocks.en: Smoke studies: visually verify airflow direction and confirm there are no eddies or dead zones
4.2.3.5 Utility systems

blocks.zh: WFI（注射用水）、壓縮空氣、真空、排水系統均可成為汙染來源：
blocks.en: WFI (water for injection), compressed air, vacuum and drain systems can all be sources of contamination:

blocks.zh: 排水管道若設計不當，可能成為逆向汙染路徑
blocks.en: A poorly designed drain line can become a back-contamination pathway

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣若未經適當過濾，會直接將微生物帶入製程
blocks.en: Compressed air that is not properly filtered will carry microorganisms directly into the process

blocks.zh: EM取樣點應涵蓋公用系統的接觸點或高風險位置
blocks.en: EM sampling locations should cover the points of contact or high-risk locations of utility systems

blocks.zh: Three criticality factor groups • Risk ranking methodology • 風險評估設計方法論
blocks.en: Three criticality factor groups - Risk ranking methodology

blocks.zh: 解析：三組關鍵性因子的架構邏輯
blocks.en: Analysis: The Structural Logic of the Three Groups of Criticality Factors

blocks.zh: RA設計的核心原則
blocks.en: Core principle of RA design

blocks.zh: TR13-2強調：若某個位置或製程步驟缺乏足夠管控且被評為高風險，則該位置自動成為微生物侵入的潛在來源，必須考慮加強管控。這一原則確保RA不只是理論評分，而必須與實際管控行動掛鉤。
blocks.en: TR13-2 stresses that if a location or process step is inadequately controlled and rated as high risk, that location automatically becomes a potential source of microbial ingress, and stronger controls must be considered. This principle ensures that the RA is not merely a theoretical scoring exercise but is tied to actual control actions.

blocks.zh: Group 1 — 製程步驟
blocks.en: Group 1: Process steps

blocks.zh: Group 1：你在做什麼？
blocks.en: Group 1: What are you doing?

blocks.zh: 製程步驟本身決定了基礎風險等級。例如：
blocks.en: The process step itself determines the baseline risk level. For example:

blocks.zh: 最終調配（Final Formulation）= High Risk（產品直接暴露）
blocks.en: Final formulation = High Risk (product directly exposed)

blocks.zh: 種子接種（Seed Inoculation）= High Risk（開放系統操作）
blocks.en: Seed inoculation = High Risk (open system operation)

blocks.zh: 設備組裝（Equipment Assemblies）= Low Risk（非直接產品暴露）
blocks.en: Equipment assemblies = Low Risk (no direct product exposure)

blocks.zh: 管路熔接（Tubing Welds）= Low Risk（密閉操作）
blocks.en: Tubing welds = Low Risk (closed operation)

blocks.zh: 這些分類會隨著製程、設備、設施年齡、管控措施的不同而調整，不能一成不變地套用。
blocks.en: These classifications change with the process, equipment, facility age and controls, and must not be applied rigidly.

blocks.zh: Group 2 — 潛在污染貢獻者
blocks.en: Group 2: Potential contributors to contamination

blocks.zh: Group 2：環境與系統設計如何影響風險？
blocks.en: Group 2: How do the environment and system design affect risk?

blocks.zh: 這是最複雜的一組，涵蓋多個維度：
blocks.en: This is the most complex group and covers multiple dimensions:

blocks.zh: 系統開放性：Open > Functionally Closed > Fully Closed
blocks.en: System openness: Open > Functionally Closed > Fully Closed

blocks.zh: 設備無菌程度：僅清潔消毒 vs. 部分滅菌 vs. 全部滅菌
blocks.en: Equipment sterility: cleaned and disinfected only vs. partially sterilized vs. fully sterilized

blocks.zh: 自動化程度：全手動 vs. 半自動 vs. 全自動
blocks.en: Degree of automation: fully manual vs. semi-automated vs. fully automated

blocks.zh: 操作時間：4-24小時 vs. <4小時 vs. <30分鐘
blocks.en: Duration of operation: 4–24 hours vs. <4 hours vs. <30 minutes

blocks.zh: 周圍房間分級：ISO 8/Grade C vs. ISO 7/Grade B
blocks.en: Surrounding room classification: ISO 8/Grade C vs. ISO 7/Grade B

blocks.zh: 溫度：>25°C（促進微生物生長）vs. 20-25°C vs. <20°C
blocks.en: Temperature: >25°C (promotes microbial growth) vs. 20–25°C vs. <20°C

blocks.zh: 人員數量與活動強度：多操作/多人員 vs. 單一操作/單一操作員
blocks.en: Number of personnel and intensity of activity: multiple operations/many personnel vs. a single operation/single operator

blocks.zh: 著裝要求：一般實驗衣 vs. 無菌完整著裝
blocks.en: Gowning requirements: ordinary lab coat vs. full sterile gowning

blocks.zh: Group 3 — 異常/意外污染源
blocks.en: Group 3: Abnormal/unexpected contamination sources

blocks.zh: Group 3：超出設計預期的風險——永遠是High Risk
blocks.en: Group 3: Risks beyond design expectations are always High Risk

blocks.zh: Group 3是TR13-2中規定最嚴格的一組：任何異常或意外的汙染源，一律視為High Risk，必須被矯正（Mitigated）。這沒有中間值，不能評為Medium或Low。
blocks.en: Group 3 is the strictest group in TR13-2: any abnormal or unexpected source of contamination is always treated as High Risk and must be mitigated. There is no middle value; it cannot be rated Medium or Low.

blocks.zh: 典型範例：
blocks.en: Typical examples:

blocks.zh: 壓差逆轉（Reverse Pressure Differential）：停電或HVAC故障導致氣流反向，低潔淨度區域空氣流入高潔淨度區域
blocks.en: Reverse pressure differential: a power outage or HVAC failure reverses airflow, so air from lower-cleanliness areas flows into higher-cleanliness areas

blocks.zh: 承包商及其設備進入：外部人員可能帶入環境中不存在的微生物種
blocks.en: Entry of contractors and their equipment: outside personnel may bring in microbial species not normally present in the environment

blocks.zh: 設施表面損壞：牆面裂縫、地板破損，提供微生物藏匿空間
blocks.en: Damaged facility surfaces: cracks in walls or broken flooring give microorganisms places to harbor

blocks.zh: 管線結露（Condensation on Piping）：潮濕表面促進生物膜形成
blocks.en: Condensation on piping: damp surfaces promote biofilm formation

blocks.zh: 發現Group 3問題後，應立即實施管控措施，並持續監控直到問題被排除。
blocks.en: After a Group 3 problem is found, controls should be implemented immediately and monitoring continued until the problem is eliminated.

blocks.zh: Mammalian Cell Culture • High / Medium / Low Risk Criteria • 哺乳動物細胞培養製程立即操作區域
blocks.en: Mammalian Cell Culture - High / Medium / Low Risk Criteria - Immediate process area of the mammalian cell culture process

blocks.zh: 解析：Table 4.3.1-1🔍 風險矩陣解讀
blocks.en: Analysis: Interpreting the Risk Matrix in Table 4.3.1-1🔍

blocks.zh: 如何閱讀這張表
blocks.en: How to read this table

blocks.zh: 這張表提供了「直接操作區域」（Immediate Process Area，即ISO 5/Grade A設備周圍）的風險評分標準。每一列是一個關鍵性因子，每一欄對應一個風險等級（High/Medium/Low）。
blocks.en: This table provides the risk scoring criteria for the "immediate process area" (the area around ISO 5/Grade A equipment). Each row is a criticality factor and each column corresponds to a risk level (High/Medium/Low).

blocks.zh: 在實際RA中，對每個因子評分後，可加總或加權得出整體風險等級，進而決定EM監控的強度。
blocks.en: In an actual RA, after each factor is scored, the scores can be summed or weighted to obtain an overall risk level, which then determines the intensity of EM monitoring.

blocks.zh: High Risk特徵的共同模式
blocks.en: Common pattern of High Risk characteristics

blocks.zh: 產品直接暴露於環境（Open System）
blocks.en: Product is directly exposed to the environment (Open System)

blocks.zh: 操作時間4–24小時（長時間暴露）
blocks.en: Operation time 4–24 hours (long exposure)

blocks.zh: 操作員長時間停留於ISO 5/Grade A區域
blocks.en: Operators remain in the ISO 5/Grade A area for long periods

blocks.zh: 周圍環境ISO 8/Grade C或更低
blocks.en: Surrounding environment is ISO 8/Grade C or lower

blocks.zh: 溫度>25°C（促進微生物生長）
blocks.en: Temperature >25°C (promotes microbial growth)

blocks.zh: 多項操作同時在同一房間進行
blocks.en: Multiple operations performed simultaneously in the same room

blocks.zh: 人員數量達到最大驗證負荷
blocks.en: Number of personnel reaches the maximum validated load

blocks.zh: Low Risk特徵的共同模式
blocks.en: Common pattern of Low Risk characteristics

blocks.zh: 完全密閉系統（Fully Closed），無產品暴露
blocks.en: Fully closed system with no product exposure

blocks.zh: 全自動化，最少人工干預
blocks.en: Fully automated, with minimal manual intervention

blocks.zh: 操作時間<30分鐘
blocks.en: Operation time <30 minutes

blocks.zh: 周圍環境達到ISO 7/Grade B
blocks.en: Surrounding environment is ISO 7/Grade B

blocks.zh: 溫度<20°C
blocks.en: Temperature <20°C

blocks.zh: 作業前後均執行消毒
blocks.en: Disinfection performed both before and after the operation

blocks.zh: 所有物料作業前已置入，作業中無進出
blocks.en: All materials are placed in before the operation, with no material in or out during the operation

blocks.zh: 實際案例對比
blocks.en: Comparison of real cases

blocks.zh:
種子接種（Seed Inoculation）= High Risk
直接產品暴露 + 手動操作 + 可能歷時數小時 + 作業員需全程在場 = 需要最嚴密的EM監控
blocks.en:
Seed inoculation = High Risk
Direct product exposure + manual operation + possibly several hours + operator present throughout = requires the tightest EM monitoring

blocks.zh:
管路熔接（Tubing Welds）= Low Risk
密閉系統 + 操作時間短 + 無直接產品暴露 = EM需求最低，可以較低頻率監控
blocks.en:
Tubing welds = Low Risk
Closed system + short operation time + no direct product exposure = lowest EM needs; can be monitored at a lower frequency

blocks.zh: 溫度因子特別說明：暖房（>25°C，如細胞培養溫箱周邊）促進各種微生物的生長與繁殖，即使是環境中的過客菌也可能在此增殖，因此需要更頻繁的EM取樣。
blocks.en: Note on the temperature factor: warm rooms (>25°C, such as around cell culture incubators) promote the growth and multiplication of all kinds of microorganisms; even transient environmental organisms may proliferate there, so more frequent EM sampling is needed.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Thought exercise

blocks.zh: 若某個種子接種操作，從原本的開放系統改為使用密閉連接器（Closed Connector），且操作時間縮短至30分鐘以內，請問：
blocks.en: Suppose a seed inoculation operation changes from an open system to a closed connector (Closed Connector), and the operation time is shortened to under 30 minutes. Consider:

blocks.zh: 「Open/Functionally Closed/Fully Closed System」因子如何變化？
blocks.en: How does the "Open/Functionally Closed/Fully Closed System" factor change?

blocks.zh: 「Length of Time」因子如何變化？
blocks.en: How does the "Length of Time" factor change?

blocks.zh: 整體風險等級是否會下降？應如何調整EM頻率？
blocks.en: Does the overall risk level go down? How should the EM frequency be adjusted?

blocks.zh: Mammalian Cell Culture • 支援區域關鍵性因子（走廊、更衣室、設備清洗區）
blocks.en: Mammalian Cell Culture - Criticality factors for supporting areas (corridors, gowning rooms, equipment wash areas)

blocks.zh: 解析：Table 4.3.1-2🔍 支援區域的差異
blocks.en: Analysis: Table 4.3.1-2🔍 Differences for Supporting Areas

blocks.zh: 支援區域 vs. 直接操作區域
blocks.en: Supporting areas vs. immediate process areas

blocks.zh: Table 4.3.1-2🔍是針對「支援區域」（Supporting Area）的版本，與Table 4.3.1-1的主要差異在於：
blocks.en: Table 4.3.1-2🔍 is the version for "supporting areas" (Supporting Area). Its main differences from Table 4.3.1-1 are:

blocks.zh: 製程步驟分類不同：支援區域的「High Risk」是指發生在其旁邊的關鍵製程（如種子接種），而非支援區域本身的活動
blocks.en: Different classification of process steps: in a supporting area, "High Risk" refers to a critical process taking place next to it (such as seed inoculation), not to the activity of the supporting area itself

blocks.zh: 新增了獨特因子
blocks.en: Unique factors added

blocks.zh: 濕度控制（Humidity Control）：缺乏濕度控制 = High Risk
blocks.en: Humidity control: no humidity control = High Risk

blocks.zh: 促生長物質的存在（Growth-promoting Materials）：開放水源、排水孔 = High Risk
blocks.en: Presence of growth-promoting materials: open water sources, drains = High Risk

blocks.zh: 交通流量（Traffic Routes）：走廊/氣鎖 = High Risk，專用房間 = Low Risk
blocks.en: Traffic routes: corridors/airlocks = High Risk, dedicated rooms = Low Risk

blocks.zh: 溫度的Low Risk標準更嚴格：Table 4.3.1-2🔍將冷藏溫度（2–8°C）列為Low Risk，而非只是<20°C
blocks.en: Stricter Low Risk criterion for temperature: Table 4.3.1-2🔍 lists refrigerated temperature (2–8°C) as Low Risk, rather than just <20°C

blocks.zh: 促生長物質的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of growth-promoting materials

blocks.zh: 支援區域特有的風險因子：開放水源、排水孔、CIP/SIP站、安全淋浴等都屬於High Risk。這是因為：
blocks.en: Risk factors specific to supporting areas: open water sources, drains, CIP/SIP stations and safety showers are all High Risk. This is because:

blocks.zh: 水是最有效的微生物生長培養基之一
blocks.en: Water is one of the most effective microbial growth media

blocks.zh: 排水孔常見假單胞菌屬（Pseudomonas）、洋蔥伯克霍爾德菌（Burkholderia cepacia）等水相環境菌
blocks.en: Drains commonly harbor waterborne organisms such as Pseudomonas and Burkholderia cepacia

blocks.zh: 這些菌株可能隨人員移動或氣流傳播至製造區
blocks.en: These organisms can be carried by personnel movement or airflow into the manufacturing area

blocks.zh: EM計畫應在含排水孔的支援區域附近設置取樣點，作為預警指標。
blocks.en: The EM program should place sampling locations near supporting areas that contain drains, as early-warning indicators.

blocks.zh: Traffic Route因子的實際意涵
blocks.en: What the traffic route factor really means

blocks.zh: 走廊（Hallways）和氣鎖（Airlocks）被評為High Risk，這與直覺略有不同——這些區域本身並無產品暴露，為何是High Risk？
blocks.en: Hallways and airlocks are rated High Risk, which is slightly counterintuitive. These areas themselves have no product exposure, so why High Risk?

blocks.zh: 原因在於：這些區域承擔著汙染傳播媒介的角色。高流量的走廊和氣鎖是不同潔淨度等級之間的過渡地帶，人員、物料、設備在此頻繁交叉，是汙染從低潔淨度區域進入高潔淨度區域的主要路徑。因此EM監控必須覆蓋這些「交通節點」。
blocks.en: The reason is that these areas act as vectors for spreading contamination. High-traffic hallways and airlocks are the transition zones between different cleanliness grades, where personnel, materials and equipment frequently cross, and they are the main pathway by which contamination moves from lower-cleanliness to higher-cleanliness areas. EM monitoring must therefore cover these "traffic nodes".

blocks.zh: Risk Criteria to Establish EM Sample Locations • EM取樣位置風險準則
blocks.en: Risk Criteria to Establish EM Sample Locations

blocks.zh: 解析：EM取樣位置的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Analysis: The Logic for Selecting EM Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: 從風險等級到取樣位置的對應關係
blocks.en: Mapping from risk level to sampling locations

blocks.zh: Table 4.3.2-1🔍建立了一個由風險等級決定取樣點考量範圍的邏輯架構：
blocks.en: Table 4.3.2-1🔍 establishes a logical framework in which the risk level determines the range of sampling locations to consider:

blocks.zh: Low Risk：不在產品路徑上，但需監控人員動線（Traffic Patterns）和接觸點（Vectors）——因為即使不直接接觸產品，這些地方也能反映整體環境衛生水準
blocks.en: Low Risk: not in the product pathway, but traffic patterns (Traffic Patterns) and vectors (Vectors) must be monitored, because even without direct product contact these places reflect the overall level of environmental hygiene

blocks.zh: Medium Risk：靠近開放操作的設備外表面——不直接暴露，但可能受飛濺或氣流影響
blocks.en: Medium Risk: external surfaces of equipment close to open operations; not directly exposed, but may be affected by splashes or airflow

blocks.zh: High Risk：每個關鍵製程操作，包含人員動線、接觸點，以及最重要的——靠近開放操作且在產品路徑上的設備表面
blocks.en: High Risk: every critical process operation, including traffic patterns, vectors and, most importantly, equipment surfaces close to open operations and in the product pathway

blocks.zh: 兩個核心概念的定義
blocks.en: Definitions of two core concepts

blocks.zh: Traffic Patterns（人員動線）：人員在製造區內的移動路徑。每次移動都會引發氣流擾動，可能將地面微粒揚起。EM取樣點應設置在人員行走路徑的關鍵節點。
blocks.en: Traffic Patterns: the movement paths of personnel in the manufacturing area. Every movement disturbs the airflow and may raise particles from the floor. EM sampling locations should be placed at key nodes along personnel walking paths.

blocks.zh: Vectors of Contamination（汙染載體）：人員會用手觸摸的表面——門把、設備開關、操作臺邊緣、鍵盤等。這些表面是微生物從人員轉移到環境的橋樑，即使在Low Risk區域也必須監控。
blocks.en: Vectors of Contamination: surfaces that personnel touch with their hands, such as door handles, equipment switches, work-table edges and keyboards. These surfaces are the bridge by which microorganisms transfer from personnel to the environment, and they must be monitored even in Low Risk areas.

blocks.zh: 文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation requirements

blocks.zh: 取樣點選擇的科學依據必須書面記錄，並納入：
blocks.en: The scientific rationale for selecting sampling locations must be documented and incorporated into:

blocks.zh: EM性能確認（EMPQ）方案：為每個製造房間建立取樣點的初始科學依據
blocks.en: The EM performance qualification (EMPQ) protocol: establishes the initial scientific rationale for the sampling locations in each manufacturing room

blocks.zh: 變更控制文件：當例行EM計畫有所調整（增加/減少取樣點）時，必須透過變更控制記錄調整依據
blocks.en: Change control documents: when the routine EM program is adjusted (sampling locations added or removed), the rationale for the adjustment must be recorded through change control

blocks.zh: 這確保EM計畫的每個決策都有可追溯的風險評估支撐，符合法規預期的文件化要求。
blocks.en: This ensures that every decision in the EM program is supported by a traceable risk assessment, meeting the documentation expectations of regulators.

blocks.zh: Table 4.3.3-1🔍: Risk-linked monitoring frequency • 基於風險等級的監控頻率
blocks.en: Table 4.3.3-1🔍: Risk-linked monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: 解析：監控頻率的三層邏輯
blocks.en: Analysis: The Three-Tier Logic of Monitoring Frequency

blocks.zh: High Risk = 動態監控（Dynamic/Batch-linked）
blocks.en: High Risk = dynamic monitoring (Dynamic/Batch-linked)

blocks.zh: 「每次關鍵操作時」意味著EM是與批次製程掛鉤的，而不是固定日期的例行監控。若本週有三批種子接種，則該High Risk位置需取樣三次；若某週無此操作，則無需取樣。
blocks.en: "At every critical operation" means that EM is linked to the batch process rather than being routine monitoring on fixed dates. If there are three seed inoculations this week, that High Risk location needs to be sampled three times; if there is no such operation in a given week, no sampling is needed.

blocks.zh: 這種設計的好處：當問題發生時，可以直接將EM數據與特定批次的操作記錄對照，快速追溯汙染源。
blocks.en: The benefit of this design: when a problem occurs, the EM data can be compared directly with the operating records of the specific batch, allowing the source of contamination to be traced quickly.

blocks.zh: 歷史數據驅動的頻率調整
blocks.en: Frequency adjustment driven by historical data

blocks.zh: TR13-2特別指出：表格中的頻率是參考基準，實際頻率應依據歷史EM資料調整：
blocks.en: TR13-2 points out that the frequencies in the table are a reference baseline, and the actual frequency should be adjusted based on historical EM data:

blocks.zh: 若某Medium Risk位置長期數據顯示極低菌落計數 → 可依風險評估降低頻率（需文件支撐）
blocks.en: If a Medium Risk location has shown very low colony counts over a long period -> the frequency may be reduced based on the risk assessment (with documented support)

blocks.zh: 若某Low Risk位置出現上升趨勢 → 應臨時提高頻率進行調查性監控
blocks.en: If a Low Risk location shows an upward trend -> the frequency should be temporarily increased for investigational monitoring

blocks.zh: 新設施：缺乏歷史數據，應從更頻繁的監控開始，待數據積累後再做調整
blocks.en: New facilities: with no historical data, start with more frequent monitoring and adjust once data have accumulated

blocks.zh: 這體現了TR13-2的生命週期方法（Lifecycle Approach）：EM計畫應隨著製程知識的積累而持續優化。
blocks.en: This reflects the lifecycle approach (Lifecycle Approach) of TR13-2: the EM program should be continually optimized as process knowledge accumulates.

blocks.zh: 4.3.4 結論的核心訊息
blocks.en: Core message of the 4.3.4 conclusion

blocks.zh: TR13-2的Section 4以四個層次完成了EM風險評估的方法論框架：
blocks.en: Section 4 of TR13-2 completes the methodological framework for EM risk assessment in four layers:

blocks.zh: 三層RA體系（4.0）：設施RA → 製程RA → EM RA，層層遞進
blocks.en: Three-tier RA system (4.0): facility RA -> process RA -> EM RA, each building on the last

blocks.zh: 八大汙染源（4.2）：任何設施都應考量的基礎因子
blocks.en: Eight sources of contamination (4.2): basic factors that any facility should consider

blocks.zh: 三組關鍵性因子（4.3.1）：結構化地將汙染風險量化為High/Medium/Low
blocks.en: Three groups of criticality factors (4.3.1): a structured way of quantifying contamination risk as High/Medium/Low

blocks.zh: 風險與監控掛鉤（4.3.2–4.3.3）：風險等級決定取樣位置與頻率
blocks.en: Linking risk to monitoring (4.3.2–4.3.3): the risk level determines sampling locations and frequency

blocks.zh: 這個架構是科學驅動的（Science-based）、系統化的（Systematic），並且是可文件化的（Documentable）——完全符合現代GMP法規對風險管理的期望。
blocks.en: This framework is science-based (Science-based), systematic (Systematic) and documentable (Documentable), fully consistent with the expectations of modern GMP regulations for risk management.

blocks.zh: Table 4.3.3-1🔍：風險等級與監控頻率的映射
blocks.en: Table 4.3.3-1🔍: Mapping of risk level to monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: 這張表是整個風險評估架構的最終輸出：根據前面所有關鍵性因子的綜合評分，決定每個位置的監控頻率。
blocks.en: This table is the final output of the whole risk assessment framework: based on the combined scoring of all the preceding criticality factors, it determines the monitoring frequency for each location.

blocks.zh: Section 4 (Part A) 核心要點總結
blocks.en: Section 4 (Part A) Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 架構知識
blocks.en: Framework knowledge

blocks.zh: 三層RA：設施RA → 製程RA → EM RA，TR13-2聚焦第三層
blocks.en: Three-tier RA: facility RA -> process RA -> EM RA; TR13-2 focuses on the third tier

blocks.zh: 製程流程圖是RA的基礎工具，多功能團隊執行，廠房巡視為必要補充
blocks.en: The process flow map is the basic tool of the RA, performed by a multifunctional team, with facility tours as a necessary supplement

blocks.zh: 八大汙染源中，人員（4.2.1）是最大風險，設施設計（4.2.3）涵蓋五個子因子
blocks.en: Of the eight sources of contamination, personnel (4.2.1) is the largest risk; facility design (4.2.3) covers five sub-factors

blocks.zh: 三組關鍵性因子：Group 1（製程步驟）/ Group 2（環境與設計因子）/ Group 3（異常源，永遠High Risk）
blocks.en: Three groups of criticality factors: Group 1 (process steps) / Group 2 (environment and design factors) / Group 3 (abnormal sources, always High Risk)

blocks.zh: 應用重點
blocks.en: Application points

blocks.zh: High Risk特徵：開放系統 + 長時間操作（4–24h）+ ISO 8/Grade C環境 + 高溫（>25°C）
blocks.en: High Risk characteristics: open system + long operation (4–24 h) + ISO 8/Grade C environment + high temperature (>25°C)

blocks.zh: Low Risk特徵：完全密閉 + 全自動化 + <30分鐘 + ISO 7/Grade B環境
blocks.en: Low Risk characteristics: fully closed + fully automated + <30 minutes + ISO 7/Grade B environment

blocks.zh: 監控頻率：High Risk=每次關鍵操作（動態），Medium=每週，Low=兩週一次
blocks.en: Monitoring frequency: High Risk = every critical operation (dynamic), Medium = weekly, Low = every two weeks

blocks.zh: EM計畫需文件化取樣點依據，納入EMPQ協議或變更控制
blocks.en: The EM program must document the rationale for sampling locations and include it in the EMPQ protocol or change control

blocks.zh: 新設施應從較高頻率開始，依歷史數據逐步調整
blocks.en: New facilities should start at a higher frequency and adjust gradually based on historical data
